The old proposal low quadruped description was inaccurate and NOT followed.
identity_review: Recognizable match to actual archive; central/side head peaks, narrow pale eyes, gold forehead and belly, juvenile proportions, biped feet and spiked tail retained. Arm armor facets and gold highlights are stylized, not pixel-identical. No Lawachurl anatomy transferred.
small_size_review: 106/127px retained distinct crown, belly stripe, separate short limbs and spike-tail. Fine claw/armor facets merge; usable source direction only.
edge_limitation: Low-alpha fringe/specks extend farther than visible solid silhouette. Raw alpha preserved. Small preview is not native antialiasing/crop safety proof; later native adaptation should test 6% inset contain without trimming.
